title: Vintage Kodak Pocket Instamatic 30 Camera - Made In USA Uses 110 Film
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Cameras:Other Vintage Cameras
descriptionText: The Vintage Kodak Pocket Instamatic 30 Camera is a classic piece of American-made photographic equipment, known for its compact size and use of 110 film. With a sleek black design and the trusted Kodak brand, this camera is a nostalgic reminder of a bygone era in photography. Perfect for collectors or photography enthusiasts looking to experiment with vintage technology, the Kodak Pocket Instamatic 30 offers a unique and stylish way to capture memories.
